paper.title_en: Finite-time memory detectors and fully constraining Faddeev-Kulish dressings in QED and gravity
paper.abstract_en: We show that for both QED and perturbative quantum gravity, time dependent Faddeev-Kulish dressings can be fully constrained either by symmetry, or by demanding that they reproduce the correct outgoing classical memory contribution. For gravity, we show that using this dressing to construct finite-time Fock spaces allows us to recover both the first order gravitational memory, as well as higher order Christodoulou contributions from the gravitational field. We explain how these higher order perturbative corrections arise in inclusive in-in calculations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文研究QED与微扰量子引力中Faddeev-Kulish dressings的完全约束问题，并将有限时间Fock空间与引力记忆（含Christodoulou高阶贡献）联系起来，属于引力量子场论基础与红外结构的前沿理论工作，理论深度较高，值得深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 有限时间记忆探测器与QED及引力中完全约束的Faddeev-Kulish dressing
decision.abstract_zh: 我们证明，对于QED和微扰量子引力两者，含时的Faddeev-Kulish dressing都可以被完全约束：或者通过对称性，或者通过要求它们重现正确的出射经典记忆贡献。对于引力，我们证明，使用这种dressing来构造有限时间Fock空间，使我们既能恢复一阶引力记忆，也能从引力场中恢复更高阶的Christodoulou贡献。我们解释了这些更高阶的微扰修正如何在包容性的in-in计算中出现。
